narrative: A striped barber-surgeon's pole and dented brass bleeding-basin hanging from an iron bracket above a narrow timber shop-front in Bishopsgate Street on a grey October morning, wet cobbles and wooden street-posts below, the stone arch of Bishopsgate rising through the mist at the end of the vista. No hand and no face.
